notes: PAYROLL AND STAFF LOANS KEPT TOGETHER; GRA E-VAT ASKS BEFORE IT SIGNS OR CANCELS. A loan instalment comes off a loan only with the payroll journal that credits the staff-loan receivable, and goes back on if that journal is reversed. A payroll post that stops part-way finishes when you press Post again; until then the month cannot be reopened or more payslips approved. Loans are recorded and written off only on Staff Loans; the staff-loan receivable cannot be changed while loans are owed; supplier bank file rows are kept as made. GRA E-VAT (still off until you switch it on) asks GRA before signing or cancelling a document it may already hold, and a credit note no longer gets stuck behind its refund. The Help guide covers all of it. Installing: database changes (0228–0229) that alter no posted figure. Carries everything in 0.8.149. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
